cues.title: The landing
cues.note: [Let “Based on a true story” land. The embers become Aloha. No extra narration.]

cues.title: Meet C-ARMAGOTCHI
cues.note: Meet C-ARMAGOTCHI. A machine you can actually care about. Disconnected? It feels ghosted.

cues.title: Overdue
cues.note: Patch overdue? It gets needy. Very needy.

cues.title: Updating
cues.note: Updating. Personal growth takes a moment.

cues.title: Connected
cues.note: Connected and current. New software, new me.

cues.title: Failure
cues.note: A failed update stays visible.

cues.title: Recovery
cues.note: Recovery brings our old friend back.

cues.title: The loop
cues.note: [Let the accelerating character loop and TV shutdown finish.]

cues.title: Now
cues.note: [Pause. Let the room change.]

cues.title: Invisible connectivity
cues.note: The personality makes you care. The system takes care of the work.

cues.title: A real day
cues.note: This is the day the hospital planned. Every case matters. An empty square alone is not permission to update.

cues.title: The opening
cues.note: Then a case is cancelled. An opportunity appears.

cues.title: Search
cues.note: Our scheduler searches the operating plan, device use and update requirements together.

cues.title: Challenge the gap
cues.note: It challenges each gap against emergency demand, recovery time and backup coverage.

cues.title: The golden window
cues.note: Here is the strongest eligible candidate in this demonstration. Cio can be serviced, and another device remains available.

cues.title: The decision
cues.note: Medical physics reviews the proposal. A person owns the decision.

cues.title: The system
cues.note: The workflow is simple to see.

cues.title: The intelligence
cues.note: Specialists find the opportunity and check readiness. Tested rules constrain the plan.

cues.title: The human
cues.note: People authorize the window and the start.

cues.title: The connection
cues.note: Our robot concept brings power and the approved package to the parked machine.

cues.title: The return
cues.note: Verification and logs close the loop. Our working prototype demonstrates the planning and handoffs. These live clinical connections are the next step.

cues.title: Our job
cues.note: We take care of the machine.

cues.title: Their job
cues.note: You take care of the patient. [Hold. Finish.]
